about: The tester's judgement of tests/junk_sample.py's 200 random POIs of the Eastern Province (seed 2501, out/places.db sha256 433f6be5...). Judged by reading name, category, district, position and neighbours on 2026-11-04, with knowledge of the area; nobody visited the places and no outside source was asked. Every id of the sample not listed in junk or minor was judged fine. A row has one class, the worst. wrong_category: its category is clearly another kind. duplicate: the same place as a row within 150 m that the merge missed. code_name: a bare number or code as the name. not_a_place: a page, joke or group, or a foreign listing. wrong_location: not where it says or on a pile of rows at one coordinate. advert: an advertisement as the name.
